title: Requirement Document
content:
Requirement Documents
### Introduction
The product idea is to create an authentication page (onboarding) and a dashboard with a graph, KPIs, and a datatable. The requirements for this project are outlined below.

### Functional Requirements
* User authentication and authorization
* Onboarding process for new users
* Dashboard with graph, KPIs, and datatable
* Data visualization and reporting
* User profile management

### Non-Functional Requirements
* Performance: The system should be able to handle a minimum of 100 concurrent users
* Security: The system should comply with industry-standard security protocols
* Usability: The system should be user-friendly and easy to navigate
* Scalability: The system should be able to scale up or down as needed

### User Stories
* As a user, I want to be able to log in to the system securely
* As a user, I want to be able to view my dashboard with graph, KPIs, and datatable
* As an administrator, I want to be able to manage user profiles and access levels

## 2.

title: Project Planning Document
content:
Project Planning Documents
### Project Overview
The project involves creating an authentication page and a dashboard with a graph, KPIs, and a datatable.

### Project Scope
* Create an authentication page (onboarding)
* Create a dashboard with graph, KPIs, and datatable
* Integrate user profile management

### Project Timeline
The estimated project duration is 4 weeks.

### Project Milestones
* Week 1: Complete authentication page (onboarding)
* Week 2: Complete dashboard with graph, KPIs, and datatable
* Week 3: Integrate user profile management
* Week 4: Testing and deployment

## 3.

title: Technical Architecture & Delivery Plan
content:
Technical Architecture & Delivery Plans
### Technical Overview
The system will be built using a web-based architecture with a front-end and back-end.

### Front-end
* Framework: React or Angular
* Library: D3.js for data visualization
* UI Components: Material-UI or Bootstrap

### Back-end
* Framework: Node.js with Express.js
* Database: MySQL or MongoDB
* API: RESTful API

### Deployment
* Cloud Platform: AWS or Google Cloud
* Containerization: Docker
* Orchestration: Kubernetes

## 4.

title: Integrated Project Management Plan (IPMP)
content:
Integrated Project Management Plans (IPMP)
### Introduction
The IPMP outlines the project management approach for the project.

### Project Organization
* Project Manager: Responsible for overall project management
* Technical Lead: Responsible for technical architecture and delivery
* Development Team: Responsible for development and testing
* QA Team: Responsible for quality assurance

### Communication Plan
* Regular team meetings
* Weekly progress updates
* Issue tracking and resolution

### Change Management
* Change request process
* Change impact assessment
* Change approval and implementation

## 5.

title: Schedule & Cost Plan
content:
Schedule & Cost Plans
### Project Schedule
The estimated project duration is 4 weeks.

### Week 1: Authentication Page (Onboarding)
* Task: Design and develop authentication page
* Duration: 5 days
* Cost: $5,000

### Week 2: Dashboard with Graph, KPIs, and Datatable
* Task: Design and develop dashboard
* Duration: 5 days
* Cost: $5,000

### Week 3: User Profile Management
* Task: Integrate user profile management
* Duration: 5 days
* Cost: $3,000

### Week 4: Testing and Deployment
* Task: Test and deploy the system
* Duration: 5 days
* Cost: $2,000

### Total Cost
The estimated total cost for the project is $15,000.

## 6.

title: Quality, Risk & Procurement Plan
content:
Quality, Risk & Procurement Plans
### Quality Plan
* Code reviews
* Unit testing
* Integration testing
* User acceptance testing

### Risk Plan
* Technical risks: Complexity of the system, integration issues
* Schedule risks: Delays in development, testing, and deployment
* Budget risks: Cost overruns, changes in scope

### Procurement Plan
* Software licenses: D3.js, Material-UI, etc.
* Cloud services: AWS or Google Cloud
* Hardware: Servers, storage, etc.

## 7.

title: Testing & Release Plan
content:
Testing & Release Plans
### Testing Plan
* Unit testing: Test individual components
* Integration testing: Test integration of components
* User acceptance testing: Test the system with real users

### Release Plan
* Alpha release: Internal release for testing and feedback
* Beta release: External release for testing and feedback
* Production release: Final release to production environment

### Deployment Plan
* Cloud deployment: Deploy to AWS or Google Cloud
* Containerization: Use Docker for containerization
* Orchestration: Use Kubernetes for orchestration

The estimated testing and release duration is 5 days.

title: Screen Inventory
content:
Here is a suggested page list and structural component-based wireframe descriptions for the auth page and dashboard:

**Page List:**

1. Login Page
2. Registration Page
3. Forgot Password Page
4. Dashboard Page
5. Settings Page

**Login Page:**

* Header:
	+ Logo
	+ Navigation menu (with links to registration and forgot password pages)
* Form:
	+ Email input field
	+ Password input field
	+ Login button
	+ Forgot password link
* Footer:
	+ Copyright information
	+ Terms and conditions link

**Registration Page:**

* Header:
	+ Logo
	+ Navigation menu (with links to login and forgot password pages)
* Form:
	+ First name input field
	+ Last name input field
	+ Email input field
	+ Password input field
	+ Confirm password input field
	+ Registration button
* Footer:
	+ Copyright information
	+ Terms and conditions link

**Forgot Password Page:**

* Header:
	+ Logo
	+ Navigation menu (with links to login and registration pages)
* Form:
	+ Email input field
	+ Send password reset link button
* Footer:
	+ Copyright information
	+ Terms and conditions link

**Dashboard Page:**

* Header:
	+ Logo
	+ Navigation menu (with links to settings and logout)
* Sidebar:
	+ Navigation menu (with links to different sections of the dashboard)
* Main Content:
	+ Grid:
		- KPI 1 (with value and label)
		- KPI 2 (with value and label)
		- KPI 3 (with value and label)
	+ Graph:
		- Line chart or other type of graph
	+ Datatable:
		- Table with columns and rows of data
* Footer:
	+ Copyright information

**Settings Page:**

* Header:
	+ Logo
	+ Navigation menu (with links to dashboard and logout)
* Form:
	+ User information (with input fields for first name, last name, email, etc.)
	+ Password change (with input fields for current password, new password, and confirm new password)
	+ Save changes button
* Footer:
	+ Copyright information

As for generating a PNG design, I'm a text-based AI and do not have the capability to create visual designs. However, I can provide you with a simple text-based representation of the wireframe using ASCII art:
```

|                  Header               |
+---------------------------------------+
|  Logo  |  Navigation Menu  |  Logout  |
+---------------------------------------+
|                  Sidebar             |
+---------------------------------------+
|  Navigation Menu  |  Section 1  |  Section 2  |
+---------------------------------------+
|                  Main Content        |
+---------------------------------------+
|  Grid  |  KPI 1  |  KPI 2  |  KPI 3  |
|  Graph  |  Line Chart  |  Data  |
|  Datatable  |  Table  |  Columns  |  Rows  |
```

Note that this is a highly simplified representation and is not intended to be a final design. You will need to use a design tool or work with a designer to create a visually appealing and user-friendly design.
